create.name: Kia Miller
create.bio:
Kia Miller grew up on a farm in the Falkland Islands, and the war that reached the islands when she was thirteen left her with a lasting wish to work for peace. After years of activism in England, and a career in modelling and film that took her around the world, she found that changing the world had to start with her own mind, and yoga became the way to do that. She settled in Los Angeles in the 1990s, trained intensively in Vinyasa and Kundalini yoga with teachers in the United States and India, and later studied in the Himalayan tradition.

She is the founder of Radiant Body Yoga, a method that weaves flowing Vinyasa together with Kundalini kriyas, pranayama, mantra and meditation, and draws on Tantra and the Yoga Sutras. Through the RBY Academy she runs Yoga Alliance-certified 200- and 300-hour trainings and sixty-hour modules on subjects such as prana, kriya and the mind, many of them live online. She also leads retreats and immersions in places from Costa Rica to India, teaches at yoga festivals, and keeps an online studio of classes and live talks. Her YouTube channel has full kriya and mantra practices.

courses.title: Radiant Body Yoga Studio with Kia Miller
courses.description: Her online studio: a library of more than a hundred Vinyasa, Kundalini, kriya, breathwork, mantra and meditation classes, plus a calendar of live talks and practices with Kia. Annual and quarterly memberships are offered.

courses.title: Prana & Pranayama 60-HR Module
courses.description: A week-long live online module of the RBY Academy on life force and the breath, combining study of yogic texts with daily pranayama practice. It can be taken alone or towards advanced certification.

free_resources.title: Kia Miller Podcast Conversations
free_resources.description: Recorded conversations between Kia and fellow teachers on yoga as a sacred practice, emotional life and Kundalini. Each episode runs around an hour.
